title: Rapid Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the LS2 Rapid Black pairs retro roadster charm with modern multi-density cranial protection. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1285g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~97 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: LS2 open face with inner sun visor for urban riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for open-face fit; may run slightly small for users with larger occipital bumps.

technical_analysis: Features Kinetic Polymer Alloy (KPA) / HPFC High Performance Fiberglass Composite shell construction paired with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield. The interior utilizes Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the LS2 Rapid Black: combining Spain / China 🇪🇸🇨🇳 craftsmanship with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield and Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: LS2 Rapid Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the LS2 Rapid Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in LS2's Open Face lineup, the Rapid Black brings Spanish engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The LS2 Rapid Black represents LS2's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the LS2 Rapid Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
